text:
sam: Quick creative ask for the webinar next week -- need a compact "bench presspack" set: hero slide, 3 micro-tiles, and a 1-page sales leave-behind. Brand-safe, low-effort, ready for localization. Due EOD Wed.

tess: Copy and assets ok to reuse existing latency/cost sparkline? or do you want fresh numbers? :question:

sam: Reuse sparkline but change the label to 'avg token cost' and include a tiny legend. Keep hero minimalist.

anya: Localization scope: en-US, en-GB, DE. Keep copy short (<90 chars per tile) so translations fit. Legal flagged "inference economics" phrase; pinging legal for approved language.

leo: Asset specs: hero 1200x628 PNG + Figma file; micro-tiles 600x600 SVGs; one-pager A4 PDF + editable Figma. Naming: redwood_bench-webinar_YYYYMMDD_v1.

leo: Accessibility: check contrast for orange CTA (#FF6A00) on dark gradient. If <4.5:1, use white outline or swap to #FF7A3A. Also include alt-text snippets in the figma export notes.

anya: Need alternate social versions: 1:1 crop with minimal copy, no logos for paid socials. Also light/dark variants.

sam: Here's the hero/tile copy (keep tight):

```
Hero headline: Serving wins: predictable inference costs for production LLMs
Hero subhead: Optimize batching, caching, and model routing to reduce per-token spend.
Tile 1: Faster responses, lower cost  smart batching
Tile 2: Pin models, rollouts, and safe fallbacks
Tile 3: Dedicated pools for consistent throughput
CTA: See benchmarks  (link to be added at handoff)
```

leo: I'll do initial sketches tonight. @tess can you set up the Figma page hierarchy and export presets? I'll add micro-illustration direction and color swatches.

tess: Yep. Quick callout  do we want the sparkline on a micro-tile or integrated into the hero? Mobile legibility is a concern.

sam: Put the sparkline in Tile 1 as a separate, labeled microvisual. Keep hero copy clean.

design-bot: deploy:asset-template-v2 applied to thread 1723456789  auto-export presets queued (png/svg/pdf).

anya: Legal constraint: avoid absolutes like "costless" or "free." Use qualifiers such as "reduced" or "lower" only.

leo: Noted. Posting first Figma link tomorrow by 10:30am PT for review. :palette: :thumbsup:

sam: Thanks  we'll bundle the one-pager for sales handoff once approved. Please label exports with environment tags (hosted/dedicated/private) when relevant.

tess: I'll leave comments on spacing and iconography after upload.

sam: :rocket:
